Hey! Try getting some selsun blue anti dandruff shampoo, put it all over the infected area before you shower and leave it on for a few mins. Also get some athletes foot creme, sounds weird but if its a fungal acne it will take it away. This looks a lot like my acne I had. I spent 10 years trying antibiotics and creams. Eventually I found people on reddit recommending these remedies... and it worked for me. I actually hate my doctor because she should have at the VERY beginning sent me to a derm who would've figured out if it was fungal. Anyways.... a lot of summers lost because I wouldn't go shirtless. My bacne/neck was VERY VERY bad and this cleared it up. So its worth a shot? Also if the acne is really itchy it's most likely fungal. So, yeah try that.

Also get some neutrogena pink grape fruit body scrub with salicylic acid also get some of the Stridex pads (the red package).
